summary.name: Sketch
summary.one_liner: Sketch is a macOS vector design tool for designing, prototyping, and collaborating on digital interfaces, made by designers for designers.
summary.what_it_does: Sketch is a macOS design editor with an infinite canvas, a vector editor, and layout tools such as stack layouts and nestable frames. It includes prototyping features like overlays, hover/press/drag/swipe interactions, and scroll areas, and prototypes can be tested in a web browser, on iPhone, or iPad. Collaboration features include real-time co-editing, sharing whole documents or password-protected previews, pinning comments and resolving threads, and a shared Workspace for team files and libraries. The page also mentions 100s of free templates, Frame presets, and component libraries, and that the app works offline.
notable: Vector editor and infinite canvas built for macOS
Prototypes testable in any web browser, iPhone, or iPad
Works offline, with optional real-time co-editing
Guest editors who already pay for Sketch are not charged extra
caveats: Component variants and sections are in beta
Pricing details are not stated on the page
